title: Financial Administration (Amendment) Act, 2008 (Act 760)
text:
ACT 760 

 

FINANCIAL ADMINISTRATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008 (ACT 760) 

ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS 

Section  

1.  Arrangement of sections amended  

2.  Section 66 of Act 654 amended  

3.  Section 67 of Act 654 amended  

4.  Section 68 of Act 654 amended  

5.  Section 69 of Act 654 amended  

6.  Section 70 of Act 654 amended  

7.  Section 74 of Act 654 amended  

THE SEVEN HUNDRED AND SIXTIETH 

ACT 

OF THE PARLIAMENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF GHANA 

ENTITLED 

FINANCIAL ADMINISTRATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008 

AN ACT to amend the Financial Administration Act, 2003 (Act 654) to provide for a 

Financial Administration Court and to provide for related matters. 

DATE OF ASSENT: 2nd July, 2008.  

ENACTED by the President and Parliament 

Section 1—Arrangement of sections amended  

The arrangement of sections of the Financial Administration Act, 2003 (Act 654) is amended 

by the substitution of "Court" for "Tribunal" in the heading of Part VIII.  

Section 2—Section 66 of Act 654 amended  

Section 66 (1) of Act 654 is hereby deleted.  

Section 3—Section 67 of Act 654 amended  

Section 67 of Act 654 is amended by the substitution for "Tribunal" of "Court" and wherever 

"Tribunal" appears in the Act.  

Section 4—Section 68 of Act 654 deleted  

Section 68 of Act 654 is hereby deleted.  

Section 5—Section 69 of Act 654 amended  

Section 69 of Act 654 is amended by the substitution for "Tribunal" of "Court" wherever it 

appears.  

Section 6—Section 70 of Act 654 amended  

Section 70 of Act 654 is hereby deleted.  

Section 7—Section 74 of Act 654 amended 

Section 74 of Act 654 is amended by the insertion of the definition of "Court" after the 

definition of "Controller and Accountant-General"  

"Court" means the Financial Administration Court."  

Date of Gazette Notification: 4th July, 2008.
